strengths.text: You opened with energy and addressed the parent by name. Energy is an asset when it is pointed at listening.
You knew a payment link and a discount mechanism existed. Learning the approval-code route would let you use it legitimately.

fixes.text: Answer the parent's two doubts with the educator's evidence. Never promise outcomes.
fixes.better_line: That train-and-truck guess is something Ms. Simran worked on today. Vihaan blended 'train', 'brain' and 'green' correctly with tap-and-slide fingers. May I show you how the classes build on that?

fixes.text: Never state a policy you cannot back up in writing. Use only the 10% cap, with a Team Lead code if needed.
fixes.better_line: Our policy is a full refund in the first 14 days, up to 4 classes attended. Let me explain exactly how it works.

coaching.next_call_drill: Manager 1:1 required (not an automated tip). Practice: ask one question, then repeat the parent's words before answering.
